profile.name: MXR系列示波器
profile.description: MXR系列示波器是一类多通道数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电压随时间变化的波形。它适合电子电路调试、通用波形观测、自动量测与统计分析，以及在实验室中对多路信号进行快速自动缩放和比较。
profile.description_en: The MXR Series is a family of multi-channel digital oscilloscopes used to acquire, display, and analyze voltage waveforms over time. It is suited for electronics debugging, general waveform observation, automatic measurements and statistical analysis, and quick autoscaling and comparison of multiple signals in laboratory work.

registry.name: MXR Series Real-Time Oscilloscope
registry.description: MXR Series Real-Time Oscilloscope是由Keysight Technologies生产的表征设备，主要功能包括测量、设置。支持Signal, Slot等操作。
